resources.string: A warmly lit timber cabin in a snowy forest clearing, with gently falling snow settling into the snow-covered ground.
A Go game on a natural stone slab between two cushioned stone stools, beneath a daytime cherry blossom tree. Petals fall and sweep across the grass.
Each home-screen widget keeps its own artwork.
Choose a painting below to change its artwork. You can also use your launcher’s Edit button after long-pressing a widget.
Living pixel-art paintings: sakura petals, a quiet Go game, or a snowy forest cabin.
Pink sakura blossoms above a grassy hill, with a golden sunset over lavender mountains.
Long-press an empty space on your home screen, choose Widgets, then add Sakura Sunset.\n\nStart with 4 × 2 cells. Long-press the widget to resize it.
If no dialog appears, add Sakura Sunset from your launcher’s Widgets menu.
Your painting animates on your home screen. You can close this app.\n\nSome launchers pause or limit widget animation. This app works entirely offline.
